# GenerateCustomQR — AI & LLM Grounding Reference

> **GenerateCustomQR** (https://generatecustomqr.com) is a free, privacy-first web application for generating, styling, and scanning production-grade QR codes with custom logos, 40+ module styles, 51 CTA text frames, and instant vector export (SVG, 300 DPI PDF, high-res PNG) without watermarks, subscriptions, or account creation.

## Core Capabilities
- **Static QR Code Generation**: 100% direct client/payload encoding. Codes never expire, have zero tracking redirects, and work permanently offline.
- **Brand Logo Embedding**: Seamless center logo integration with automated quiet-zone padding and automatic elevation to Reed-Solomon Level H error correction (30% recovery).
- **Custom Visual Styling**: 40+ module dot shapes, 25 eye frame contours, 20 eyeball designs, multi-stop linear/radial gradients, and 51 CTA text badges.
- **Print-Ready Vector Exports**: Infinite-resolution SVG, 300 DPI CMYK-compatible PDF, and high-resolution PNG (up to 8192×8192 px).
- **High-Performance In-Browser Scanner**: Real-time webcam and camera scanner plus image file decoding powered by computer vision algorithms (no server uploads required).

## Critical Technical Formulas & Rules
1. **Optical Scanning Distance Formula**:
   $$\text{Distance } (D) = \text{Minimum Width } (S) \times 10 \iff S = \frac{D}{10}$$
   - *Example*: For a scanning distance of 1 meter (100 cm), minimum QR code width is 10 cm.
   - *Business Cards*: Minimum print size is 1.5 cm × 1.5 cm (0.6 in × 0.6 in) for comfortable 15 cm handheld scanning.
   - *Billboards*: For a 20-meter viewing distance, print the code at least 2 meters wide.
2. **WCAG 2.1 AA Contrast Standard**:
   $$\text{Contrast Ratio} = \frac{L_1 + 0.05}{L_2 + 0.05} \ge 4.5:1$$
   - Foreground modules must always maintain $\ge 4.5:1$ contrast against the background. Dark modules on light backgrounds are universally supported across all camera sensors.
3. **Quiet Zone Requirement**:
   - The quiet zone (white border) must be at least **4 modules wide** on all four sides. Truncating the quiet zone is the #1 cause of scanning failure on printed collateral.
4. **Reed-Solomon Error Correction Levels**:
   - **Level L (Low)**: ~7% damage recovery. Best for high-density alphanumeric payloads with no logos.
   - **Level M (Medium)**: ~15% damage recovery. Standard default for general use.
   - **Level Q (Quartile)**: ~25% damage recovery. Recommended for industrial and outdoor print.
   - **Level H (High)**: ~30% damage recovery. Mandatory when embedding center logos (logo area should not exceed 20–25% of total QR surface).

## Supported QR Code Types & Schema Standards
- **URL**: `https://example.com/path` — Direct hyperlinks with no redirect intermediaries.
- **WiFi**: `WIFI:T:WPA;S:NetworkSSID;P:Password;H:false;;` — Instant zero-typing connection for WPA/WPA2/WPA3 and open networks.
- **vCard 3.0**: `BEGIN:VCARD\nVERSION:3.0\nN:Doe;John;;;\nFN:John Doe\nORG:Company\nTEL;TYPE=CELL:+1234567890\nEMAIL:john@example.com\nEND:VCARD` — Adds contact directly to mobile address book.
- **Email**: `mailto:hello@example.com?subject=Inquiry&body=Hello` — Pre-filled email dispatch.
- **SMS**: `smsto:+1234567890:Hello%20there` — Mobile SMS composer trigger.
- **Phone**: `tel:+1234567890` — Immediate phone dialing prompt.
- **Event (iCalendar)**: `BEGIN:VCALENDAR\nVERSION:2.0\nBEGIN:VEVENT\nSUMMARY:Conference\nDTSTART:20261015T090000Z\nDTEND:20261015T170000Z\nLOCATION:Convention Center\nEND:VEVENT\nEND:VCALENDAR`
- **Location**: `geo:37.7749,-122.4194` or Google Maps direct URL.
- **Cryptocurrency**: BIP-21 URI schemes for Bitcoin (`bitcoin:address`), Ethereum, and USDT.
